QuestInfo.name: Dangerous Experiments
QuestInfo.0: Carson, the Zenumist President has something to ask of you in secret. Go find Carson.
QuestInfo.1: Carson tells you that the Zenumist have gotten hold of the #bChimera#k made in the Alcadno laboratory. Carson further explains that if this becomes known, there will be chaos while asking you the eliminate the #rChimera#k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Chimera made in the Alcadno laboratory as Carson requested.

0.0: You CANNOT tell anyone what I am about to tell you. Recently, my Zenumists acquired a special test subject, created in the laboratories of Alcadno. I can say no more about how we acquired it.
0.1: This particular subject appears to be a cross between machine and lizard. It is extremely dangerous...the Alcadno have created a true monster!
0.2: If anyone found out about this, it would cause chaos throughout Magatia. That is why I must ask for your help.

yes.0: The #rChimera#k was hidden in the deepest part of #b#MDmirrorD_326_2_##k. It is a monster that should never have existed, and should not be used by anyone. So I need you to eliminate the #rChimera#k. We do not possess the ability to handle such a monster ourselves.

no.0: Really, now... The unholy combination of lizard and machine, designed for war, does not concern you?

1.0: Did you get rid of that horrendous thing?

yes.0: This confirms everything. Alcadno is conducting unforgivable experiments. We can't just let him be.

default.0: Go eliminate the dangerous test subject #rChimera#k that the Alcadno created. It should never have existed in the first place.
